product: 330 ml aluminium can bodies, direct from a can maker
moq: FULL TRUCKLOAD / SIX-FIGURE. Printed-can minimums found: 150,000 pieces per variety per order (Austria, published on a supplier site) and ~200,000 pieces (Germany, two independent trade reports). Minimum for UNDECORATED/BRITE cans direct from a can maker was NEVER ESTABLISHED
status: STRUCTURAL - CONFIRMED BY TWO INDEPENDENT ROUTES
notes: A STARTUP CANNOT BUY CANS DIRECT. AT 1,700 CANS YOU ARE TWO ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE BELOW THE MINIMUM ORDER OF EVERY CAN MAKER - Ball, Crown, Ardagh, CanPack and Trivium will not quote you, and no negotiation closes a 90-150x gap. THE ONLY ROUTE TO CANS IS THE CO-PACKER'S OWN STOCK OF BLANK CANS, or a blank-can reseller. This is exactly why small European drink brands can exist at all: BeverageScouts offers test fillings from 1,000 cans and applies labels 'in a second work step', Taste Your Brand fills from 50 litres (~150 cans) on its own in-house line, and Canable and Bayerndose both offer label/decoration support - none of which is coherent unless they are drawing from their own can stock. THEREFORE, ASK EVERY CO-PACKER TWO SEPARATE MOQ QUESTIONS, ALWAYS: (1) 'What is your minimum FILLING quantity?' and (2) 'What is your minimum CAN PURCHASE quantity - do you stock unprinted/brite 330 ml cans, and can you apply our sleeve or label instead of requiring a printed can run?' A filler who will happily run 2,000 litres of liquid may still be unable to buy fewer than a truckload of cans. THIS IS THE SINGLE MOST COMMON REASON A PROMISING QUOTE COLLAPSES.

company: *** WARNING ROW - DIGITALLY PRINTED CANS AND THE DRS TRAP ***
product: Digitally printed cans
status: STRUCTURAL WARNING - DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE AT PRINT TIME
notes: EVEN IF A CHEAP LOW-MOQ DIGITAL CAN PRINTER EXISTS, PRINTING ONTO METAL IS THE WRONG CHOICE FOR BATCH 1. Below ~5,000 cans placed on the Hungarian market in a calendar year the product very probably falls outside mandatory DRS: no 50 HUF deposit, no MOHU registration, no 45-day pre-launch gate, AND NO DRS MARK ON THE ARTWORK (status: LIKELY - NEEDS PROFESSIONAL CONFIRMATION). Above 5,000 all of that becomes mandatory. PRINT DRS-LESS ARTWORK ONTO METAL AND YOU HAVE HARD-CAPPED THAT INVENTORY AT 5,000 UNITS FOREVER; print the DRS mark on and you have committed to the deposit system before you know whether the product sells. A LABEL OR SLEEVE KEEPS THE DECISION REVERSIBLE - you print 1,700 non-DRS sleeves now, and when volume justifies it you print DRS sleeves for the same blank cans and scrap zero cans. A first Hungarian label for a novel functional drink will also need at least one revision (nutrition panel, allergen declaration), which costs a reprint on a sleeve and a five-figure write-off on printed cans. RESERVE SPACE IN THE ARTWORK NOW for the DRS mark, the deposit-value text ('visszavaltasi dij: [X] Ft') and the GTIN, even though batch 1 omits the mark - retrofitting means re-originating the whole layout.
